name: The Bad Guys: The Series
description: How did the Bad Guys break into the bad guy business in the first place? Find out in this hilarious prequel series set before the hit films.

videos.title: Bad Beginnings
videos.overview: Mr. Wolf and his loyal band of thieves set out to make a name for themselves by stealing an iconic painting from the local museum.

videos.title: The Sweet, Sweet Steal
videos.overview: Still itching to be recognized for their crimes, the Bad Guys set out to swipe a top-secret recipe from a suspiciously sweet candy maker.

videos.title: No News Is Bad News
videos.overview: Wolf arranges for the team to be interviewed on the news as a way to hype up their heists. But are the Bad Guys really ready for prime time?

videos.title: This Means Chore
videos.overview: Tired of living in a messy lair, Piranha creates a household chore wheel. (Sorry, Mr. Wolf, but planning the perfect heist will have to wait.)

videos.title: The Webs, the Wigglesworth and the Wardrobe
videos.overview: After bungling a heist, Webs is worried the team might want to kick her out — so she asks a legendary escape artist to teach them all some new tricks.

videos.title: It's a Hard Heist Life
videos.overview: When an anti-aging cream transforms Snake into an adorable baby, the Bad Guys use his cuteness to try and pull a long con on a childless baron.

videos.title: Heist on the Run
videos.overview: The Bad Guys set out to out-heist the infamous Night Owls... but bragging about it online before they've actually succeeded puts them in a tough spot.

videos.title: Home Is Where the Heist Is
videos.overview: Suspecting Snake is hiding something, the rest of the Bad Guys tail him to a mysterious mansion and find themselves face-to-face with a legendary thief.

videos.title: Crime After Crime
videos.overview: The Bad Guys discover Wolf's dearly departed mentor left him an inheritance. But to get it, the gang will have to pull off five heists in just one night!

videos.title: The Heist-Over
videos.overview: Something smells fishy! When the Bad Guys can't find Piranha — and can't remember anything from the night before — they attempt to retrace their steps.

videos.title: The Con Test
videos.overview: Can the Bad Guys keep their criminal instincts in check? Webs acts as ref while the rest try to make it to the end of the day without pulling a heist.

videos.title: Natural Heistory
videos.overview: The Bad Guys get in touch with their primal side when an extinct wolfanderthal criminal busts out of icy captivity — and into the present.

videos.title: A Nice Day for a Bad Wedding
videos.overview: Snake recruits the crew to steal away his mom's happiness after she surprises him with news that she's marrying one of the Bad Guys's biggest enemies.

videos.title: Me Mentor Mori
videos.overview: On the hook for his own bad deeds, Wolf's legendary mentor mysteriously returns to claim the rest of his loot — and cast some doubt among the squad.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: To keep their crime streak on full throttle, the Bad Guys look to join forces with some cosplaying copycats who badly need the crew's crooked advice.

videos.title: I, Webs
videos.overview: The gang convinces Webs to hack together an AI-powered getaway car. But things take a wrong turn when their advanced auto tech tries to take control.

videos.title: Bad Actors
videos.overview: Everyone goes gaga for a superstar's new movie as the Bad Guys head to Hollywood, where Shark's dreams of the spotlight keep their crime streak alive.

videos.title: Fear the Ripper (1)
videos.overview: One steal away from becoming legends, the Bad Guys meet their match in a vengeful vigilante with plans to polish off all crime in one fell swoop.

videos.title: Fear the Ripper (2)
videos.overview: Thanks to a crusading crime stopper known as the Ripper, the city is unrecognizable. Can the Bad Guys pull out all their tricks to get their city back?
